notes: tile_ft 9.99999999999999999999 makes a tile 9.99999999999999999999 x 304.8 = 3047.999999999999999996952 mm, so footprint_mm 3048 spans ceil(3048 / 3047.999999999999999996952) = 2 tiles per axis. The shed is 2 x 2: at 7,0 it needs column 8, at 6,0 it covers 4 tiles. Areas use tile_ft as a double (10.0), so 4 x 100 = 400 sq ft. Read as a double, tile_ft is 10.0 and the shed would be 1 x 1. The house's [6000, 4500] spans 2 x 2 either way.
